description: RSS/Atom feed finder — Finds and validates the RSS, Atom or JSON Feed of any website: link rel=alternate tags, feed-looking links, then common paths (/feed, /rss.xml, /atom.xml, /index.xml...). Each candidate is fetched and checked: format, title, item count, newest item date, days since last post, latest item. Verdict FEED FOUND / FEED FOUND BUT STALE / NO FEED FOUND. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: web_feed_discover
